_comment: Antumbra DNS resolver list. Shown in the first-run wizard. Not Mozilla's TRR partner list. Edit requires DECISIONS.md note on reasoning (ARCHITECTURE.md 5.7).

resolvers.name: Quad9
resolvers.description: Non-profit. Switzerland. No logging of source IPs. Blocks known malware domains.

resolvers.name: Mullvad
resolvers.description: Privacy-focused VPN provider. Sweden. No-log policy. No malware filtering.

resolvers.name: AdGuard
resolvers.description: Independent. Cyprus. No logging. Blocks ads and trackers at the DNS level.

resolvers.name: Cloudflare 1.1.1.1
resolvers.description: US-based. Largest CDN provider. Logs anonymised queries for 24 hours per privacy policy.

resolvers.name: Use my system resolver
resolvers.description: Uses your network's default DNS. Right choice if you trust your ISP, run Pi-hole, or use a VPN with its own DNS.

resolvers.name: Custom URL
resolvers.description: Enter a DNS-over-HTTPS URL. For people who run their own resolver.
